description: Whether hybrid retrieval actually finds the passage that answers the question, measured against a maintained golden corpus.

metrics.description: Share of answerable golden questions whose expected evidence appears in the top five retrieved passages.
metrics.measurementMethod: For each answerable golden question, run the full hybrid retriever and check whether any of the first five results matches the expected file and unit. Report the mean.

metrics.description: Share of answerable golden questions whose expected evidence is the single best result.
metrics.measurementMethod: As recall_at_5, restricted to the first result. Tracked continuously and optimised; not a release gate on its own.

metrics.description: Share of the top five retrieved passages that are genuinely relevant.
metrics.measurementMethod: Mean over golden questions of relevant results within the first five, divided by five.

metrics.description: Mean reciprocal rank of the first correct passage.
metrics.measurementMethod: Mean of 1/rank of the first matching result across answerable golden questions; zero when no match is retrieved.

metrics.description: Normalised discounted cumulative gain over the first five results.
metrics.measurementMethod: Standard nDCG with binary relevance and log2 position discount, normalised by the ideal ordering.
metrics.standardReference: Jarvelin & Kekalainen, Cumulated gain-based evaluation of IR techniques, ACM TOIS 20(4), 2002.

metrics.description: Change in Recall@5 against the previously recorded baseline.
metrics.measurementMethod: Current Recall@5 minus the baseline recorded for the previous release on the same corpus.
